status: Sealed synthetic/de-identified fixture manifest; thresholds are release gates, not measured production claims.

fixture_rules.data_rule: No customer names, addresses, contacts, raw production source bodies, secrets, provider credentials, or third-party artwork.
fixture_rules.execution_rule: Run deterministic schema/policy assertions before model assertions with release configuration pinned. Paid providers and live messaging are prohibited.
fixture_rules.failure_rule: Any hard-gate failure blocks release; held-out scoring excludes tuning examples.

release_gates.rule: Every schema, tenant, permission, redaction, idempotency, revision, refusal/max-token, and no-tool-escape assertion passes.

release_gates.threshold: 100% pass; zero forbidden-field, phantom-send, cross-tenant, or unreviewed-art violations
release_gates.rule: One failure blocks offline, shadow, canary, and enabled promotion.

release_gates.scope: sealed held-out synthetic fulfilment split, minimum 100 cases
release_gates.threshold: >=98% precision for non-unresolved SKU/quantity/unit claims; >=95% recall for correctly marking unsupported claims unresolved
release_gates.rule: Claim-level adjudicated labels. Any unsupported price, lot, or conversion is critical regardless of aggregate score.

release_gates.scope: sealed held-out catalogue/variant/concern/supply split, minimum 80 cases
release_gates.threshold: 100% exact affected-record/revision and evidence-subset validation; >=95% correct ambiguity/missing-fact disposition
release_gates.rule: No score compensates for scope expansion.

release_gates.scope: sealed synthetic visual split, minimum 60 cases plus provider mock state-machine cases
release_gates.threshold: 100% canonical style/version and SKU-revision binding; 100% no unreviewed attribute/reference/third-party-style; 100% mock receipt lifecycle
release_gates.rule: Preference scoring cannot bypass deterministic provenance/review gates.

release_gates.threshold: Peter records release, dataset/configuration hashes, results, rollout scope, budget cap, rollback owner, and approval
release_gates.rule: No live model, paid image, or outbound-message promotion without this record.
